---
title: "Render course"
output: html_document
date: "2022-08-12"
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r }
library(rmarkdown)
root <- getwd()

for (j in 1:4) {
    render(input = paste0(root, "/lecture", j, "/slides.Rmd"),
           output_options = list(includes = list(after_body = "slides_elements/insert-logo.html")),
           output_file = paste0(root, "/lecture", j, "/slides.html"))
}
render(input = paste0(root, "/home.Rmd"), output_file = paste0(root, "/home.html"))

```
